title: Teotihuacan becomes a major urban centre
summary: Teotihuacan in central Mexico developed monumental complexes and a planned urban landscape during the first to seventh centuries CE. Its influence extended through Mesoamerican cultural and artistic networks.

The city offers a major urban comparison with contemporary centres in Eurasia and Africa. Its later name should not be mistaken for a secure identification of every community that built or inhabited it.
